experiment: Same physical prefix, conditional first root by each native continuation controller
selection: Retain all three Linux/.95 original seeds and the same natural first-divergence states; no outcome filtering or anchor replacement.
new_arm: Consume the full ordinary BG native anchor proposal from its own original BG prefix state, force only the registered finite first physical root, then freely replan using unchanged ordinary BG.

cached_arms.B_root_F_controller: completed source forced BG first root then finite

null_validation: Fixed seed42 ordinary BG null suffix reproduces complete cached frames/native logical fees/jobs/raw snapshots/lane events/end. All three science native anchor proposals/context/fees reproduce their cached BG anchor.
restore: Reconstruct BG own outer RNG/counter from its cached causal FIFO/counts and original eligible planning samples; retain its own post-proposal state. Restore complete waiting FIFO and all existing lane commitments from its own physical checkpoint. Never transplant finite planner state into BG.
snapshot_semantics: Raw trajectory snapshots retain original all-birth1200 semantics. Independently recompute both arms actual900 state from jobs for the after900 intervention. Performance outcomes retain original cohort900/1200 semantics.
integrity: Committed prefix jobs unchanged; canonical births identical across all four arms; exactly one first-action override; no replanning after selecting the forced action at the anchor; all later actions ordinary BG. Preserve all outcomes and class tails.
fee_scope: Separate three scientific suffixes, one validation suffix and prefix RNG reconstruction. Charge native BG anchor/suffix logical work, extra MW support scan, constructors/state/FIFO reads and actual CPU. Reuse the three completed finite counterfactual suffixes without rerunning them. All complete trajectories remain server-side; transfer only small JSON.

root_effect_orientation.interaction: finite_controller root effect minus BG_controller root effect

interaction_population: Mean and unfinished contrasts use the identical birth cohort. P90 interaction is available only when all four arms finish the identical cohort at the cutoff; otherwise retain pairwise common-ID P90 outcomes and leave interaction unavailable.
interpretation: Each within-controller root contrast is a conditional causal effect. Cross-controller differences include each native prefix memory, full anchor proposal consumption and later decisions; they do not isolate a pure suffix-type switch. No additive whole-policy benefit, independent confirmation or new adoption gate.
decision_boundary: Compare all three root-effect signs across the two native controllers. A sign reversal points to controller interaction; stable signs support examining root ranking. Preserve class-tail costs. No coefficient scan, general class/oldest/loaded guard, full24 rerun or paper edit.
